기타.title: 대성하이텍, 이스라엘 블루버드와 군용 드론 국산화 추진
기타.summary: 대성하이텍이 이스라엘 블루버드 에어로 시스템즈와 군용 드론의 국내 생산과 해외 수출 사업에 나선다.  11일 대성하이텍에 따르면 다음달 8일부터 11일까지 경기 고양시 킨텍스에서 열리는 방산전시회 '대한민국 국제지상군방위산업전시회(K-DEX 2026)'에 블루버드와 공동 부스를 마련한다. 블루버드는 2002년 설립된 이스라엘의 군용 무인기 전문기업이다.  이번 전시에서는 블루버드의 정찰용 수직이착륙(VTOL) 드론과 장시간 감시정찰용 드론, 배회형 정밀타격 드론, 소형 1인칭 시점(FPV) 드론 등 4종을 공개할 예정이다.

기타.title: 헤그세스 탄핵 일단 무산…美민주, 내년 회기 재추진 예상(종합)
기타.summary: 미국 하원이 피트 헤그세스 국방장관에 대한 탄핵 추진을 저지하면서 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 공화당 지도부가 정치적 승리를 거뒀다는 평가가 나왔다. 다만 내년 1월 민주당이 의회 다수당을 차지하면 탄핵이 재추진되면서 정치적 공방이 다시 격화할 수 있다는 전망도 제기됐다. 10일(현지시간) AP통신과 영국 가디언 등에 따르면, 미 하원은 이날 헤그세스 장관에 대한 탄핵소추안을 법사위원회로 회부하는 동의안을 찬성 211표, 반대 204표로 가결했다. 이번 표결은 탄핵안 자체에 대한 찬반이 아니라 법사위 회부 여부를 결정하는 절차 표결이다.

기타.title: 韓, 디지털·AI 경쟁력 세계 10위… 정부 핵심시스템 지수 '최고'

top5_headlines.title: 1년새 3687억달러 늘어난 韓수출 … 74%는 '반도체 힘 '
top5_headlines.summary: 반도체 수출, 지난해 11월10일까지 1392억달러 올해 4134억달러로 3배 가까이 급증 반도체 중심 수출구조 심화…韓경제 새도약 시험대 한국 수출이 사상 처음 연간 1조달러 달성을 눈앞에 뒀다. 인공지능(AI) 투자 확대에 따른 반도체 슈퍼사이클이 수출을 끌어올린 결과다. 올해 수출 증가분의 74.3%를 반도체가 차지할 정도로 성장 기여도가 압도적이다.

key_headlines.title: Korea Achieves 80% Localization Rate in Robot Core Components
key_headlines.summary: South Korea is advancing robot component localization with sensors, actuators, and battery development. Plans include commercializing actuators by 2029 and humanoid batteries by 2030, with 49.8 billion won allocated for on-sensor AI technology development.

key_headlines.title: South Korea's Exports Surge 368.7 Billion Dollars in One Year, 74% Driven by Semiconductors
key_headlines.summary: Korean exports are on track to hit a historic 1 trillion dollars annually, with semiconductor exports nearly tripling from 139.2 billion to 413.4 billion dollars year-over-year due to AI investment expansion.

key_headlines.title: Deputy Prime Minister Announces 2027 Economic Growth Strategy Focusing on Potential Growth and Inequality Reduction
key_headlines.summary: The government will prioritize enhancing potential growth rates and addressing polarization as key tasks in the December 2027 economic growth strategy, with economic forecasts to be released three times yearly instead of twice, a first in 32 years.

key_headlines.title: Stock Market Settlement Period to Shift from T+2 to T+1 with Six-Month Testing Period
key_headlines.summary: The Ministry of Economy and Finance plans to transition from the current T+2 settlement cycle to T+1, requiring at least six months of system testing beforehand to ensure adequate preparation and address global investor concerns.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI and KOSDAQ Rally on AI Investment Optimism
key_headlines.summary: Domestic stock markets surged with KOSPI rising 2.60% and KOSDAQ jumping 5.62% on improved AI investment sentiment and foreign investor buying, marking consecutive days of gains despite earlier market volatility.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's export sector is experiencing unprecedented growth with exports poised to reach 1 trillion dollars for the first time, driven overwhelmingly by semiconductor exports that account for 74.3% of the annual export increase. The semiconductor supercycle, fueled by global artificial intelligence investment expansion, has become the primary engine for economic growth. The government plans to support core robot component localization, targeting 80% domestic production rates with commercialization timelines set for 2029-2030. Deputy Prime Minister Lee Hyung-il has announced major policy initiatives including revised economic forecasts and task forces to address income polarization while sustaining growth momentum.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government is implementing its 2027 economic growth strategy with dual focus on enhancing potential growth rates and reducing economic polarization. The Bank of Korea is expected to raise base rates by 0.25 percentage points in both November and February based on strong export performance, while fuel tax reduction measures will be extended for two additional months. Economic forecasts will be issued three times annually starting in 2027, a change implemented for the first time in 32 years to respond swiftly to changing domestic and international conditions. South Korea's government debt-to-GDP ratio remains at approximately 50%, with fiscal deficits below 2% of GDP since 2023, demonstrating sound fiscal health.
sections.Financial Markets: Domestic stock markets rallied on November 11 with KOSPI closing up 2.60% at 5,375.36 and KOSDAQ surging 5.62%, driven by foreign investor buying worth 658.8 billion won. ETF average daily trading value has surpassed KOSPI average daily trading value for the first time at 20.38 trillion won, indicating a shift toward index and thematic investing due to weakened confidence in individual stocks. Multiple trading halts (buy-side circuit breakers) have been activated as markets experience significant volatility. The transition to T+1 settlement cycle will require extensive system preparation and global investor coordination to mitigate settlement risk concerns.
sections.Industry & Technology: General Motors unveiled its fourth-generation electric vehicle platform featuring 33% higher battery energy density through lithium-manganese-rich technology development. South Korea-US economic alliance cooperation is expanding beyond military sectors to include semiconductors and shipbuilding as strategic leverage points. The steel and petrochemical industries continue experiencing downturns, prompting extended government support for employment crisis prevention in Pohang and Seosan regions. Samsung's foldable display technology for premium devices like Apple's upcoming products commands high valuations, though pricing remains a significant challenge for market expansion.
sections.Real Estate: South Korea's real estate policy discourse has shifted toward stabilizing jeonse and monthly rental markets as priority over home price regulation, reflecting concerns about residential affordability in the Seoul metropolitan area ahead of the 2028 general election. Korea's first equity-stacking public housing in Gwangjeon New City recorded over 100-to-1 competition ratio in first-priority subscriptions, demonstrating strong demand for affordable housing alternatives. Authorities have identified 354 suspected fraudulent apartment subscription cases among 25,000 investigated, revealing schemes including false residency changes, fabricated dependent claims, and feigned job resignations. The government is implementing stricter verification procedures using medical facility usage records and workplace location data.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve is considering a 0.5 percentage point rate hike in December as consumer inflation exceeded expectations with 0.4% monthly increase, contradicting disinflationary trends. US Treasury prices have declined sharply amid heightened uncertainty about monetary policy direction, with Fed officials including Christopher Waller discussing the possibility of big-step rate increases. Congress is accelerating efforts to restrict semiconductor exports to China, with Democratic leaders expressing strong support for enhanced restrictions in the 2027 defense authorization act. Global uncertainty surrounding US mid-term elections and international political instability has prompted heightened vigilance from Korean economic officials stationed abroad.
sections.AI & Economy: Investment paradigms in artificial intelligence are shifting toward profitability verification rather than growth expectations alone, as markets reassess which AI ventures will generate sustainable returns. Global uncertainty regarding US data center regulations and AI investment policies presents opportunities for South Korea to strengthen national competitiveness, with the government planning AI funding equivalent to double the current 9.04 trillion won allocation for 2027. Coreweb demonstrated strong third-quarter results despite concerns about neoclassical cloud company sustainability amid rising interest rates and delayed facility completions. Government officials emphasize that AI market uncertainties represent strategic opportunities for Korea's technology sector advancement.
sections.Others: Deputy Prime Minister Lee Hyung-il convened the sixth 2026 economic officials meeting with Korean economic attaches stationed at 15 countries across 18 diplomatic missions to coordinate responses to complex global uncertainties including US mid-term elections, French fiscal crisis, and Middle East tensions. The government has launched a task force under the deputy prime minister to address polarization as part of comprehensive government response efforts to ensure broad-based economic benefits. Dongyang, a Eugin Group affiliate, is recovering 5.6 times its private equity fund investment through asset transfers and cash distributions including over 100 billion won in Woori Financial Group shares from PEF liquidation.
